chunks: Al-Muzaffar ibn Ja'far ibn Al-Muzaffar al-Alawi narrated to us, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Mas'ud narrated to us, from his father, saying: Ibrahim ibn Ali narrated to us, from Abdul-Adheem ibn Abdullah al-Hasani, from Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),

regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'Then, let them end their tafath.' He said: It is trimming and untidiness. He said: Among tafath is that you speak during your state of Ihram with horrid speech. If you then enter Mecca, perform the circling around the House, and speak with good speech, that would be its expiation.

key_terms.إِحْرَام: State of consecration for Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.تَفَث: Impurities or removing impurities (physical and spiritual)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'tafath' in Surah Al-Hajj according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to highlight the dual nature of 'tafath' in Hajj, extending the concept beyond physical grooming to include linguistic purification. It establishes that speaking foul words during Ihram requires expiation through the combination of Tawaf and uttering kind speech, reflecting the Shia emphasis on holistic spiritual cleanliness. This interpretation underscores the importance of controlling one's tongue as a component of ritual purity.

en.basel-kadem: 8.	We were told by Mudaffar bin Ja’far bin Mudaffar al-Alawi, that he said: We were told by Ja’far bin Muhammed bin Mas’ud, from his father, that he said: We were told by Ibrahim bin Ali, from Abdul-Adheem bin Abdullah al-Hasani, from Hasan bin Mahbub, from Mu’awiya bin Ammar, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,

with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Then, let them end their tafath» [22:29]. He said: It is to trim, and it is untidiness. He said: Among tafath is that you speak during your state of Ihram with horrid speech. If you, then, were to enter Mecca, perform the circling around the House and utter good speech, that would be its expiation.
